metadata.label: 3-Axis Elastic Spring Coupling (k_s)
metadata.description: DEsolver GENSYS three-dimensional translational elastic spring coupling with optional preload and deadband.
metadata.provenance: DEsolver GENSYS Public Element Reference (coupl k_s); EN 14363:2016+A2:2022 Rail Vehicle Dynamics

metadata.label: Linear 1D/3D Stiffness Element (k_lin)
metadata.description: Purely linear Hookean stiffness coupling used in primary and secondary rail suspension.
metadata.provenance: DEsolver GENSYS Public Element Reference (coupl k_lin); UIC 518 / EN 14363

metadata.label: Parallel Coil / Rubber Spring (k_p)
metadata.description: Parallel elastic spring coupling connecting bogie frame and wheelset axlebox or carbody bolster.
metadata.provenance: DEsolver GENSYS Public Element Reference (coupl k_p); Manchester Benchmarks (Iwnicki 1998)

metadata.label: 3-Axis Viscous Damper Coupling (c_s)
metadata.description: DEsolver GENSYS three-dimensional hydraulic viscous damper coupling with blow-off force saturation.
metadata.provenance: DEsolver GENSYS Public Element Reference (coupl c_s); EN 14363:2016+A2:2022

metadata.label: Linear Viscous Damper (c_lin)
metadata.description: Linear velocity-proportional hydraulic damper for bogie yaw, lateral, and vertical suspension.
metadata.provenance: DEsolver GENSYS Public Element Reference (coupl c_lin); UIC 518

metadata.label: Parallel Hydraulic Damper (c_p)
metadata.description: Parallel primary/secondary shock absorber element with symmetric blow-off relief.
metadata.provenance: DEsolver GENSYS Public Element Reference (coupl c_p); Manchester Benchmarks (Iwnicki 1998)

metadata.label: Maxwell Series Spring-Damper (kc_s)
metadata.description: Viscoelastic Maxwell coupling (elastic end-bush stiffness in series with hydraulic yaw/lateral damper).
metadata.provenance: DEsolver GENSYS Public Element Reference (coupl kc_s); UIC 518 Yaw Damper Modeling

metadata.label: Piecewise-Linear Bumpstop Spring (kpf_s)
metadata.description: Piecewise-linear nonlinear spring coupling modeling progressive lateral/vertical rubber bumpstops.
metadata.provenance: DEsolver GENSYS Public Element Reference (coupl kpf_s); EN 14363 Bumpstop Clearance

parameters.description: Primary linear stiffness before bumpstop contact

metadata.label: Pneumatic Secondary Airspring (k_air)
metadata.description: Thermodynamic pneumatic airspring with surge reservoir, orifice damping, and bellows shear stiffness (Berg/Nishimura).
metadata.provenance: Berg M. (1999) 'A Three-Dimensional Airspring Model with Friction and Orifice Damping', Vehicle System Dynamics; EN 14363

metadata.label: Coulomb Dry Friction Element (f_fric)
metadata.description: Regularized Coulomb dry friction coupling for freight Y25 Lenoir links, leaf springs, and center-plate friction.
metadata.provenance: DEsolver GENSYS Public Element Reference (coupl f_fric); UIC 518 Freight Bogie Friction

metadata.label: 3-Point Nonlinear Wheel-Rail Contact (wr_coupl_pe3)
metadata.description: Three-point simultaneous tread/flange wheel-rail contact coupling with Hertzian normal elasticity and Polach/Kalker creepage.
metadata.provenance: Kalker J.J. (1990) Three-Dimensional Elastic Bodies in Rolling Contact; Polach O. (2005) Wear 258:992-1000; EN 14363

parameters.description: Polach adhesion area reduction factor kA
Polach slip area reduction factor kS
Polach exponential friction decay coefficient B

metadata.label: Precalculated Rail-Elastic Wheel-Rail Coupling (wr_coupl_pra)
metadata.description: Wheel-rail contact coupling utilizing precalculated kpfr contact geometry tables with Polach/Kalker tangential forces.
metadata.provenance: DEsolver GENSYS Public Reference (wr_coupl_pra); Kalker FASTSIM (1982); EN 14363

metadata.label: Single-Point Elastic Wheel-Rail Contact (wr_coupl_pe1)
metadata.description: Single-point elastic wheel-rail contact coupling for fast stability and linearized hunting eigenvalue analysis.
metadata.provenance: DEsolver GENSYS Public Reference (wr_coupl_pe1); Kalker Linear Theory (1967); UIC 518

metadata.label: Hertzian Normal Contact Stiffness (kpf_hertz)
metadata.description: Nonlinear 3/2-power Hertzian normal wheel-rail contact elasticity with Hunt-Crossley hysteresis damping.
metadata.provenance: Hertz H. (1882) J. Reine Angew. Math.; Johnson K.L. (1985) Contact Mechanics; EN 14363

metadata.label: Kalker Linear / FASTSIM Creep Force (creep_kalker)
metadata.description: Kalker linear creepage coefficients (C11, C22, C23) with Vermeulen-Johnson / Coulomb saturation cone.
metadata.provenance: Kalker J.J. (1982) 'A Fast Algorithm for the Simplified Theory of Rolling Contact (FASTSIM)', Vehicle System Dynamics 11:1-13

metadata.label: Polach Nonlinear Creep Force (creep_polach)
metadata.description: Polach nonlinear traction/adhesion wheel-rail creep model with velocity-dependent falling friction for traction and curving.
metadata.provenance: Polach O. (2005) 'Creep forces in simulations of traction vehicles running on adhesion limit', Wear 258:992-1000

parameters.description: Ratio of limit to static friction A

metadata.label: EN 13715 / ORE S1002 Wheel Profile
metadata.description: Standard European high-speed and mainline wear-adapted wheel tread profile S1002 (h28/e32.5).
metadata.provenance: EN 13715:2020 Railway Applications — Wheelsets and Bogies — Wheels — Tread Profile (S1002); UIC 510-2

parameters.description: Equivalent conicity on 60E1 1:40 rail at 3 mm amplitude

metadata.label: UK RSSB P8 Wheel Profile
metadata.description: British Rail / RSSB standard P8 wear-adapted wheel profile designed for 1:20 inclined rails.
metadata.provenance: RSSB GM/RT2466 / EN 13715 P8 Wheel Tread Profile Specification

metadata.label: AAR-1B North American Wheel Profile
metadata.description: Association of American Railroads wide-flange 1:20 taper wheel profile for heavy-haul freight and passenger service.
metadata.provenance: AAR Manual of Standards and Recommended Practices Section G (M-107/M-208) AAR-1B Profile

metadata.label: EN 13674-1 60E1 (UIC60) Rail Profile
metadata.description: Standard European 60.21 kg/m Vignoles rail head geometry (300/80/13 mm crown radii).
metadata.provenance: EN 13674-1:2011+A1:2017 Railway Applications — Track — Rail Profile 60E1 (UIC60)

metadata.label: EN 13674-1 54E1 (UIC54) Rail Profile
metadata.description: Standard European 54.77 kg/m mainline rail profile with 300/80/13 mm head radii.
metadata.provenance: EN 13674-1:2011+A1:2017 Railway Applications — Track — Rail Profile 54E1 (UIC54)

metadata.label: ORE B176 / ERRI Track Irregularity PSD
metadata.description: Analytical spatial power spectral density (PSD) generator for ORE/ERRI B176 low/high-level track irregularities.
metadata.provenance: ORE/ERRI B176 RP1 (1989) Bogies with Steered or Steering Wheelsets; EN 14363 Annex C

metadata.label: FRA Track Class 1-6 Irregularity PSD
metadata.description: US Federal Railroad Administration (FRA) track geometry roughness PSD for Track Classes 1 through 6.
metadata.provenance: FRA 49 CFR Part 213 Track Safety Standards; Garg & Dukkipati (1984) Dynamics of Railway Vehicle Systems

parameters.description: FRA Class 6 vertical roughness constant Av
FRA Class 6 alignment roughness constant Aa

metadata.label: 6-DOF Rigid Body (mass_rigid)
metadata.description: General six-degree-of-freedom rigid body with diagonal inertia tensor in track-following coordinates.
metadata.provenance: DEsolver GENSYS Public Element Reference (mass m_rigid_6); EN 14363

parameters.description: Roll mass moment of inertia Jxx
Pitch mass moment of inertia Jyy
Yaw mass moment of inertia Jzz

metadata.label: Railway Wheelset Rigid Body (mass_wheelset)
metadata.description: Rigid railway wheelset with gyroscopic pitch inertia and nominal rolling radius.
metadata.provenance: Manchester Benchmarks (Iwnicki 1998); UIC 518 / EN 14363

metadata.label: Bogie Frame Rigid Body (mass_bogie)
metadata.description: Two-axle passenger or freight bogie frame rigid body with roll, pitch, and yaw inertias.
metadata.provenance: Manchester Benchmarks (Iwnicki 1998); EN 14363

metadata.label: Vehicle Carbody Rigid Body (mass_carbody)
metadata.description: Passenger coach or locomotive carbody rigid body supported by secondary suspension.
metadata.provenance: Manchester Benchmarks (Iwnicki 1998); EN 14363 / UIC 518

metadata.label: Fixed Kinematic Constraint (constr_fix)
metadata.description: 6-DOF rigid holonomic constraint locking relative translation and rotation between two frames.
metadata.provenance: DEsolver GENSYS Public Element Reference (constr fix_rigid); Shabana (2008) Railroad Vehicle Dynamics

metadata.label: Revolute Pin Joint Constraint (constr_rev)
metadata.description: Single-axis revolute joint constraining 5 DOFs (e.g., bogie center pivot or traction rod pin).
metadata.provenance: DEsolver GENSYS Public Element Reference (constr); Shabana (2008) Railroad Vehicle Dynamics

parameters.description: Bitmask of locked DOFs (5 of 6 locked)
